title: Inside The Fragrance Foundation’s 2026 Circle of Champions Dinner
summary: The night celebrated David Greenberg, chairman and former chief executive officer of L’Oréal USA, as he was inducted into the circle.

extraction.key_fact: 프래그런스 파운데이션 만찬에서 로레알 USA의 전 대표가 서클 오브 챔피언스에 이름을 올렸다.
